_comment: One entry per N5 hint image. 'prompt' is what the image must show; the generator sends prompt + style and nothing else. Edit freely: the script never adds wording of its own.
style: Simple flat vector illustration in a clean modern infographic style. One clear subject, centred, filling the frame, on a plain pale background. Bold clean linework, minimal detail, still readable at 200 pixels wide. Draw exactly and only what is described. No letters, no words, no captions, no labels, no Japanese or Chinese characters, no signage, no logos, no watermark. Digits only where the description explicitly asks for them. Not an anime or manga character, not a portrait, not a scene with a story: an icon-like picture of the thing described.
